name: cestacorp-treinamentos
description: Evolução de Treinamentos · Cestacorp (Projeto Service Learning PUCRS 2026/2)

scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:migrate -w @cestacorp/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:seed -w @cestacorp/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cestacorp/api" "npm run dev -w @cestacorp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @cestacorp/api && npm run build -w @cestacorp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @cestacorp/api && npm run typecheck -w @cestacorp/web
